title: Recover from a payment-processor account termination
summary: Your processor is terminating the account. Read the notice: the stated reason, the final processing date, the reserve terms. Processors commonly hold funds against future disputes for a stated period after termination; Stripe's services agreement is public and explains its reserve mechanics, so read yours. Then do three things at once. Export every record while you still have API access. Appeal through the processor's review channel with real evidence. Start underwriting at a backup processor now; onboarding takes days. Moving card data between PCI-compliant processors at the PAN level is a real, supported path, not a workaround. If payouts or renewals will wobble, tell your customers. How long the reserve is held is the processor's call; treat it as a wait.
